integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a medium shot inside a sunlit college dorm frames three young Chinese women in cozy home-wear long dresses cleaning the large window together; one sprays cleaner, one wipes the glass in circles, one holds the curtain aside as warm daylight spills through the clearing glass. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed on their easy laughter and teamwork. [Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the shot cuts to a steady medium shot by the dorm door, where the same three women pull thick winter coats and padded jackets over their long dresses, zipping up and grabbing beanies, gloves, and ski gear bags, exchanging excited glances. [Shot 3] At 00:08.000, the shot cuts to the interior of a coach bus rolling through a snowy landscape, snow-dusted hills sliding past the window as the three sit together with their gear. [Shot 4] At 00:11.000, the shot cuts to a wide tracking shot at the ski resort, where the three click into skis at the top of a gentle beginner slope and glide down together, arms slightly out for balance, snow sparkling under bright winter sun, the camera following their descent smoothly and steadily.

overall_soundscape: Soft squeaks of a spray bottle and cloth strokes on glass give way to the zip of jackets and rustle of gear bags. A bus engine hums steadily, then crisp skis carve through packed snow with light, rhythmic hissing and bright laughter.

non_diegetic_music: A light, upbeat acoustic track at a moderate tempo with ukulele and hand claps, brightening as the skiers descend and gently fading at the end.
